root_cause.text: In `nvmet_bio_done()` the NVMe target completed the request before releasing the inline `bio`, allowing `req->ops->queue_response()` to re-submit the same `nvmet_req` while `nvmet_req_bio_put()` later uninitialized the reused `inline_bio` and cleared `bio->bi_blkg`, causing a NULL dereference in `blk_cgroup_bio_start()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch reorders `nvmet_bio_done()` from `nvmet_req_complete(req, blk_to_nvme_status(req, bio->bi_status)); nvmet_req_bio_put(req, bio);` to `nvmet_req_bio_put(req, bio); nvmet_req_complete(req, blk_to_nvme_status(req, blk_status));`, and the CVE description explicitly states that `queue_response()` can re-queue the same request before `bio_uninit()` runs, leaving `bio->bi_blkg` NULL when the bio is re-submitted.

intent_record.intent_summary: Reorder bio completion to release the bio before completing the request, while preserving the status value for correct NVMe completion.
intent_record.what: In `nvmet_bio_done()`, the code now saves `bio->bi_status` into a local `blk_status_t blk_status` variable, removes the direct call to `nvmet_req_complete()` before `nvmet_req_bio_put()`, and instead calls `nvmet_req_complete(req, blk_to_nvme_status(req, blk_status))` after `nvmet_req_bio_put(req, bio)`.
intent_record.how: This changes the completion ordering so the bio reference is released before the request is completed, while preserving the original block status value for conversion to an NVMe status. It avoids using `bio->bi_status` after the bio may be affected by the put path and makes completion happen after cleanup.
